sourceRefs.locator: Monument 00400 / MNA108959, grid reference TM 2877 4869. Orientation point for Mound 1.
Room 41, Gold coins. The 37 struck coins, three blanks and two ingots, Frankish mints and a suggested deposit between 610 and 635.
